Name: Speed Stardew
Author: cowphuc123
Description:
[size=5][b]Speed Stardew[/b][/size]

Tired of standing around waiting for the day to pass, crops to grow, or machines to finish? [b]Speed Stardew[/b] speeds up the game by a multiplier you choose (x2, x3, and more). It's not just a faster clock — time, your character's movement, animations, crops, NPCs, machines, everything runs faster together.

Comes with [b]on-screen touch buttons[/b] so it works great on [b]Android[/b] too, and can keep the game running while the window is unfocused.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Speeds up everything[/b], not just time — movement, animations, crops, NPCs, machines all scale with the multiplier.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable speed[/b] from x1 up to x10 (supports half steps like x1.5, x2.5).[/*]
[*][b]On-screen buttons[/b] ( − / speed / + ) — tap the middle box to reset to x1. Fully [b]drag-to-move[/b], and they auto-hide while a menu is open.[/*]
[*][b]Mobile friendly[/b] — buttons are ON by default on Android and OFF on PC (so they don't cover your toolbar). You can override this.[/*]
[*][b]Keyboard hotkeys[/b] on PC.[/*]
[*][b]Keep running while unfocused[/b] — the game won't pause when you alt-tab (optional).[/*]
[*][b]Full config[/b] via Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[b]PC (default keys):[/b]
[list]
[*][b]>[/b] (the "." key) — increase speed[/*]
[*][b]<[/b] (the "," key) — decrease speed[/*]
[*][b]B[/b] — reset to x1[/*]
[/list][b]Mobile / touch:[/b] use the on-screen buttons. Drag the whole group to reposition it anywhere; tap the middle box to reset.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+  (on Android: SMAPI for Android)[/*]
[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu — for the in-game settings menu[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility & notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Single-player only[/b] — do not use in multiplayer (it will cause desync).[/*]
[*]Very high multipliers (x8–x10) use more CPU and may stutter on weaker devices — lower it if needed.[/*]
[*]Safe to add/remove at any time; it doesn't change your save.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
This mod is open source. Feedback and bug reports are welcome in the Posts tab.
